crime_highlights: Mr. Labbe picked up a cinder building block and struck her on the head ten times
They found Ms. Martin's dead body
Mr. Labbe confessed on videotape to killing Ms. Martin
Ms. Martin died from a number of blows to her head administered with significant force
rationale_highlights: his adoptive mother abused him when he was a child
Mr. Labbe is of Métis heritage. I took this into account when setting the appropriate range of sentence
note: Court's statement of effect is brief; no detail on how Métis heritage mattered.

crime_highlights: The accused had a firearm which looked like a 303 rifle
He fired it in the air and asked the complainants if they wanted to die today
The accused walked towards McKinnon Charlie, put the rifle next to his ear and then pulled the trigger
McKinnon Charlie developed headaches and intermittent ringing in his ear and had difficult hearing for some time
rationale_highlights: were the accused to be removed from his present position through a jail term he may very well revert to his old ways
the jurisprudence indicates that I could and should consider a conditional sentence in a case like this
note: Court never links Gladue factors to reduced culpability; systemic discussion is thin.

crime_highlights: The complainant asked him to stop and he resumed the journey but stopped again and made further advances of the same nature
he reached across and touched the complainant on the leg and breasts and kissed her
the accused said he was too tired and drunk to drive and he needed to sleep
rationale_highlights: may well have had a greater denunciatory and general deterrence effect in his small aboriginal community than it would have in a larger non-aboriginal community
In appropriate cases, some of the traditional sentencing objectives will be correspondingly less relevant in determining a sentence that is reasonable in the circumstances
I cannot conclude that he erred in principle on the matter of emphasis or that the sentence imposed was demonstrably unfit
note: Appeal court upholds short sentence partly on community-context reasoning, not culpability.
